newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ROMA SIGN RUSSIAN TETRADZE, RELEASE TROTTA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMA SIGN RUSSIAN TETRADZE, RELEASE TROTTA.

text.p: Italian first division side Roma have signed Russian international defender Omar Tetradze and sent unsettled Argentine defender Roberto Trotta back to Buenos Aires, newspapers reported on Saturday.

Trotta, 28, will join River Plate on loan for six months while Tetradze, 26, is due to be presented to the media next week when he arrives from Russian side Alania Vladikavkaz, according to the newspaper reports.
They said Roma paid the Moscow club 2.5 billion lire ($1.6 million) for the Georgian all-rounder, who will earn 500 million lire ($320,000) a year until the end of 1998.

Argentine coach Carlos Bianchi had brought Trotta with him from Velez Sarsfeld at the start of the season but the defender failed to live up to expectations, becoming the target of heavy fan criticism.
